_comment: Smallness at its limit -- the bottom of the axis `colossal` takes the top of, and the same `size`
name on the sun, the curtain, the bow, a feature and an island. `tiny rings` is a ring you could
step over; a tiny Age is every one of those things shrunk at once.
**It carries no query, where `colossal` restricts the landmass to `monumental`.** There is no tag for
the opposite of monumental and no antonym pairing one, so the mirror would have to be a negative
restriction -- the first in the corpus -- to say something the size band already says. The axis is
what this word means, so the axis is all it sets.
The bottom of the axis, with `small` the step above it: two words for little are worth having only
where they do different things, so this is -1.0 and that is -0.7 downward.
